title: Connected systems
subtitle: Ziira watches the system you already use. It only reads: it never changes anything there.
emptyHint: Connect your ERP, or upload a sales export or a bank or mobile-money statement, and Ziira starts checking.

coverage.title: What Ziira can check
coverage.subtitle: Based on what is connected today
coverage.nudge: Connect more to check more of your business.

wizard.title: Add a connection
wizard.name: Name
wizard.autoBranches: Create a Ziira branch for each of its branches automatically
wizard.readOnly: Ziira only reads. Nothing is ever written to your system, and you can withdraw the access at any time.
wizard.secretNote: Stored encrypted and never shown again.
wizard.testHint: Tries the access with the lightest read the system offers.
wizard.firstReadHint: Ziira reads your system for the first time. This can take a few minutes for a large business.
wizard.readDone: Done. Ziira has read your system.
wizard.dropFirstHint: Drop a bank or mobile-money statement, or a sales, stock or expense file, and we will find out what it is. Or choose below.
wizard.notSure: We could not tell what this file is. Choose its kind below.

branches.hint: Choose which Ziira branch each store or till of your other system is. Unmapped ones are checked at company level.
branches.unmapped: {{count}} not mapped yet: they are checked at company level.
branches.emptyHint: They appear after the first read or upload.

history.emptyHint: Reads and uploads are listed here.

oauth.title: Authorise
oauth.explain: {{title}} asks you to approve read-only access on its own page. You will come back here afterwards.
oauth.clientHint: Only needed if Ziira has no registered app for this system.
oauth.success: Access approved. You can now test and read the system.
oauth.failed: Access was not approved ({{reason}}). Try again.

upload.title: Add a file
upload.dropStatement: Drop your statement here: PDF, photo, Excel or CSV
upload.dropStatementNoPhoto: Drop your statement here: PDF, Excel or CSV (photos need the picture reader, which is not switched on yet)
upload.dropFile: Drop your file here: Excel or CSV
upload.orClick: or click to choose a file (up to {{mb}} MB). Newer files may overlap older ones: nothing is counted twice.
upload.refusedType: That kind of file cannot be read. Use a PDF, an Excel (.xlsx) file, a CSV file or a photo (PNG or JPG).
upload.refusedSize: That file is bigger than {{mb}} MB. Download a shorter period and try again.
upload.readingNote: This can take a minute or two. You can stay on this page.
upload.passwordNeeded: This PDF is protected with a password. Type the password to open it.
upload.wrongPassword: That password does not open the file. Check it and try again.
upload.passwordHint: The bank or provider gave it to you. It is used once to open the file and is never saved.
upload.nothingReadable: No lines could be read from this file.
upload.fromPicture: This was read from a picture. Computers sometimes misread a digit. Please check the lines below against your statement before you say they look right.
upload.wrongKind: This looks like a {{title}}, which is not what this connection is for. Add it as a {{title}} instead, or check you chose the right file.
upload.missing: We could not find: {{fields}}. Use “Something is wrong” to point us to it.
upload.sample: A few of the lines we found

reason.wrong_kind: May be the wrong kind of file
reason.dates: Dates can be read two ways

upload.whichDateHint: Your file writes dates as numbers, so it could be read two ways.
upload.chooseDateFirst: Tell us how the dates are written, then you can go on.
upload.fixHint: Tell us which part of your file is which. Under each choice you can see what is in it.
upload.noneOfThem: None of them (not in my file)
upload.correctTitle: Correct the lines that were hard to read
upload.correctHint: Change anything that does not match your statement, then save. Lines you correct are checked again.
upload.leftOut: {{count}} line(s) could not be used and will be left out:
upload.download: Download the list of lines left out
upload.done: {{new}} new lines were added; {{already}} were already there; {{skipped}} could not be used.

statement.1: Whether sales paid by phone or bank have a payment to show for them
statement.2: Whether cash sales were really deposited
statement.3: Money received that matches nothing, and payments that may have been made twice

sales.1: Sales entered long after the day they happened, or outside trading hours
sales.2: A branch selling far less than usual
sales.3: Cashiers with more voids, refunds or discounts than usual

invoices.1: Customers who are overdue or paying slower than before
invoices.2: Supplier invoices that may have been entered twice
invoices.3: Products that cost more than they used to

expenses.1: Expenses far above the normal for their category
expenses.2: Manual journal entries worth a look
expenses.3: Payments that may have been made twice

overview.queued: Reading queued: it starts in a moment
overview.stale: Nothing has been read for a while. Checks may be out of date.

disconnect.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
disconnect.message: Ziira stops reading this system and forgets the key. Nothing changes in your system.
disconnect.deleteData: Also delete everything Ziira read from it

settings.everyHint: How fresh the data should be.
settings.secretSet: Set. Leave blank to keep it.

first.title: Connect your first system
first.hint: Ziira checks your business as soon as it can read your sales, payments or books. Connect your ERP, or upload a sales export or a statement.
